Ways to cut heating costs

  • Heat the room you're in, with the door shut, rather than the whole house.
  • Use the thermostat and a timer rather than the highest setting.
  • Heating yourself (a blanket or heated throw) costs far less than heating the air.

How we calculate · About · Privacy & cookies

Costs use the Ofgem price cap average for 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026 (standard variable tariff, Direct Debit, England, Scotland & Wales). Your rate may differ: tap the rate at the top of any page to use your own. Figures are estimates for typical appliances; check your appliance's label for its actual power.

Your electricity unit rate

This is the pence per kWh on your bill or app. Don't use the standing charge: you pay that whether an appliance is on or not. On Economy 7 or an EV tariff, use the rate for the time the appliance runs.
